artifact_policy.reason: The task used public HTML previews only. No media was downloaded, hashed, or stored, so the artifact manifest is intentionally empty.

coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews did not expose timezone-bearing publication datetimes; records therefore use day precision and preserve preview times separately.
RVvoenkor and Colonelcassad in-window coverage was incomplete because reliable backward pagination was unavailable through the approved connector.
Upstream Reuters, Kotsnews, Russian Ministry of Defence, Rutube, and Soloviev Live materials were named but not registered because this shard was limited to Russian milblogger discovery.
The open internet was not exhaustively searched; this is a bounded discovery sample, not a completeness claim.

excluded_results.description: Late-evening RVvoenkor posts and Rybar's 19:26 daily chronicle were excluded because the connector's displayed times could fall after the 18:00Z cutoff.
Posts centered on granular active-frontline positions, map geometry, unit movements, or targeting-relevant details were not registered.
Search results for 4 August 2025 and older years were excluded.

follow_up_task_proposals.reason: Identity, ownership, historical accuracy, correction behavior, independence, and topic-specific methodology require separate evidence-backed review.
Atomic attributed observations should be extracted before any normalized claim or assessment is created.
A connector with reliable Telegram history or API access should backfill RVvoenkor and Colonelcassad for the same UTC window.
